t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes are perhaps seperated into groups. The gren, brown, orange & yellow gnomes are one group, while the pink, purple, red & blue are another group. One group will consistantly have a higher number of mushrooms depending on whether the multiplier is x1 or x5. Once you check which group has the higher number for that multiplyer, stick to that group throughout the multiplyer.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in pairs of complementary colors, eg. blue & yellow or brown and purple. I have found that there is a higher probabilty of finding more mushrooms when you stick to one side based on the pair of gnomes. Eg. When i see the blue & yellow pair, I always choose the gnome to the right. When I see the brown and purple pair, I always chose the gnome to the left. Be careful in deciding the group with the higher mushrooms. During the x1 round, the numbers range from 0-9. It is deceiving when during the x5 you see higher numbers and you may forget to divide by 5.
